svg.text: Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.
In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund
Live folk music from The Muddy Boots

g.data-flaw: Fete in its accent colour runs into Village, and the two-line white date is set small.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: the accent word should be placed after its line, not at its own measured origin; the date's two lines are merged into one band.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. Fete in its accent colour runs into Village, and the two-line white date is set small. Fixable: the accent word should be placed after its line, not at its own measured origin; the date's two lines are merged into one band.
